The main subject of the image is a black and white cat sitting on a bed with green bedding that has a subtle pattern of small crosses. The cat is positioned facing away from the camera, looking towards something off-screen. The cat's fur is predominantly black with white patches, particularly noticeable on its chest and paws. It also has a collar around its neck
